rRNA.description: Every locus RefSeq types rRNA in this annotation: six complete 5S genes and ten 16S or 23S entries that RefSeq flags partial. The truncation is the assembly's and not the biology's, this being a draft contig-level assembly in which the repeated rrn operons broke across contig boundaries.
rRNA.source: RefSeq's own gene_biotype in the registered GTF, with the 16S, 23S or 5S identity of each bare locus tag taken from the product qualifier in GCF_004354945.1_ASM435494v1_genomic.gff.gz and cross-checked against Rfam RF00177, RF02541 and RF00001. An E. coli K-12 derivative carries roughly seven 16S, seven 23S and eight 5S genes, so this list is a genuine but incomplete and partly truncated rRNA complement and will under-report.
